scope: One independent review of newly authored fig25 against the actual original PNG, frozen current n18 context, current FigureSpec and actual 640/331/342 PNG previews. Reviewer did not participate in fig25 authorship. This is not a repeated lesson/science review, product-browser acceptance or promotion.

independentSourceInventory.pixels: One coordinate frame with a vertical upward-arrow p axis and horizontal rightward-arrow T axis meeting at one lower-left zero marked 0. No calibrated tick marks, numerical scale, unit text, grid or separate subpanel is present. Small irregular ink bumps on the scanned axes are not labelled calibration ticks.

Upper, steeper positive straight line labelled V1 near its upper-right end. The portion toward the common origin is dashed; the outer positive-temperature portion is solid. It has no terminal arrowhead, marked state point or numerical reading.

Lower, shallower positive straight line labelled V2 near its right end. It shares the same origin and likewise has dashed low-temperature extension followed by solid outer line. No terminal arrowhead, state point or numerical reading.
The original states V1 < V2 above/between the axes and lines. At a common positive temperature within their shared domain the V1 line is higher than V2.

contextBinding.interpretation: Figure matches the current lesson's same fixed amount/composition of ideal gas: absolute pressure versus absolute temperature, separate fixed volumes, V1 < V2 and lower pressure for the larger volume at equal positive T. Dashed portions denote ideal-model extrapolation, not observed low-temperature states or a reachable zero-volume state. No Celsius scale, gauge-pressure reading, phase-transition temperature, velocity, energy or new exercise implication is added.
contextBinding.sourceRegularization: Straight line positions, endpoints, dash transition positions and slopes are unmeasured drawing choices explicitly identified as such in the spec. The source has no numerical axis readings or supplied volume ratio to preserve. These drawing coordinates are not instructional data.

independentReadOnlyChecks.method: Node assert/strict read-only checks against source-derived relationships and current frozen context, plus existing validate_spec.py --stage draft --json. No rerender, product tests or browser launch.

actualPixelReview.observations: At all three actual widths, p/T axis directions, common zero, both complete dashed-to-solid lines, their separate V1/V2 labels and the original inequality are visible, legible, uncropped and mutually separated. Upper V1 and lower V2 remain distinguishable. Dashes remain distinct from solid curves at the smallest width. No missing curve, extra measured tick, number, unit, cultural wording, answer annotation or graphical artefact was observed.
